sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at my hotel, checking breakfast before tomorrow's trip.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got my booking open and ask at reception.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, is breakfast included in my booking for tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me check your room number first.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's room twelve, and here's a screenshot of my booking.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, breakfast's included, so there's nothing extra to pay.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, do I need a voucher for the dining room?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yeah, here's your breakfast voucher for tomorrow morning.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I give this voucher to someone ?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, just hand it to the person by the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Now I check breakfast against my travel plans.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: What time do you start serving breakfast?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We open at seven, and breakfast ends at ten.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got to leave at seven to avoid the traffic.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, we can put together a bag for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, what can I get to go?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We've got toast and fruit to take with you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is there cereal with milk in the breakfast bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry, cereal's only for guests eating in the dining room.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, toast and a banana would be fine for me.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We'll have it ready by reception at six forty-five, if you order tonight.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, when do I need to order the breakfast bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Tonight, and pick it up at six forty-five.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check that the receptionist has my order.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can you put my name down for a breakfast bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll put your room number on the list.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I bring my voucher when I pick it up?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, please bring it to reception tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I'll pick it up here, not in the dining room?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, we'll have your bag right here for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll keep the voucher with my key.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked breakfast, placed my order, and confirmed the pickup.
